{{recipe}}

This salad consists of savory grilled chicken and spicy arugula dressed with a citrus vinaigrette.

== Ingredients ==
* 2 boneless skinless [[Cookbook:Chicken|chicken]] breasts
* 2 [[Cookbook:Cup|cups]] tightly-packed [[Cookbook:Arugula|arugula]], roughly [[Cookbook:Chopping|chopped]]
* 2 [[Cookbook:Tablespoon|tbsp]] freshly-squeezed [[Cookbook:Lemon|lemon]] juice
* 1 [[Cookbook:Teaspoon|tsp]] [[Cookbook:Dijon Mustard|Dijon mustard]]
* 6 tbsp extra-virgin [[Cookbook:Olive Oil|olive oil]], plus more for the chicken
* [[Cookbook:Salt|Salt]]
* Freshly-ground [[Cookbook:Black Pepper|black pepper]]
* Shaved (not grated) Parmeggiano-Reggiano cheese

== Procedure ==
#[[Cookbook:Brush|Brush]] both sides of chicken with extra-virgin olive oil. Season both sides liberally with salt and freshly-ground black pepper.
#[[Cookbook:Grilling|Grill]] over a preheated charcoal grill, turning often, until internal temperature reaches 165°F/73.8°C.
#Move to a plate and cover with [[Cookbook:Aluminium Foil|aluminum foil]]. Let rest 10 minutes before shredding with two forks.
#[[Cookbook:Whisk|Whisk]] together mustard and lemon juice. Slowly whisk in olive oil. Season, if desired, with kosher salt and freshly ground black pepper.
#[[Cookbook:Mixing#Tossing|Toss]] chicken with arugula and dressing.
#Top with shaved Parmeggianno-Reggiano cheese and serve chilled.
